criteria.sourceAccuracy: Each concept, numerical relation, and experimental condition was checked against the authoritative scanned spread; OCR was used only as a locator.
criteria.curriculumAlignment: Coverage was cross-checked with the current MEXT junior-high science curriculum commentary.
criteria.ibarakiExamReadiness: Every unit combines accurate recall with experiment design, evidence interpretation, graph/table reading, calculation, and causal explanation aligned with Ibaraki public-exam analysis.
criteria.calculationAudit: Ohm's law, electric power and energy, electrolysis ratios, reaction mass ratios, humidity, dew point, and condensation calculations were independently recomputed with units.
criteria.distractorAudit: Choice distractors are same-domain misconceptions and do not duplicate the correct answer.
criteria.originality: Prompts, numerical datasets, diagrams, tables, and graphs are original and do not reproduce the textbook exercises or artwork.
criteria.contextCompleteness: All 240 prompts were checked for dangling references. Every question that depends on a graph, table, diagram, or named sample now displays that source material in the same question.
criteria.mobileAccessibility: All 35 figure uses have required alternative text and captions and use safe data-driven rendering within a 390px viewBox.

limitations: This pack completes the scanned second-year science review; third-year science remains separate work.
Mastery strengthens entrance-exam readiness but cannot guarantee admission; timed mixed-year past-paper practice is still required.
